procedure.procedureContent:
Select one actual completely described ritual, its real owner/leader and participants, and one completion. A class feature explicitly activated as Ritual can qualify even when nonspell; a spell with an actual Ritual permission can qualify under its own source. A name containing Ritual, Rite or ceremony, an ordinary long cast, or Ritual Anchor's empty ordinary payload set is not proof. Mastery is not itself made a free Wizard Ritual-tag cast simply by its name. Spellbook Study is a genuine Wizard Ritual; Mage Soulbound Ritual is an Action feature and is excluded. A ten-minute Teleportation Circle is a long cast, not automatically a ritual.
KEEP ten-minute root work and26RP. NEW continuous work requires concentration, capable speech/hands/focus or actual M alternative, and each own regular Action in initiative for600seconds. The target's actual owner consents to the specific ritual and remains within120feet/line of effect; actual participants, materials, place and eligibility must remain present as their source requires. Initiating Mastery commits its own cost/history/counter window once, not100 times. Every real intervening start/end, recharge, Ready expiry and required save is processed. Another spell/Action incompatible with this work, incapacity, range loss, voluntary abandonment, actual suppression preventing work, or failed damage-concentration check interrupts it; no partial completion, payment refund or instant restart follows. Losing the initial cast to Counterspell spends the root but never spends an unbegun target ritual's later fee.
At600 completed seconds, atomically recheck the named ritual and participants. Compress ONLY that ritual's remaining active performance time to zero. Pay its actual independently required consumedRP/HP/material/limited use, use its actual leader's check/DC, risk consent, success/failure table and outcome. Source-permitted0RP/nonspell rituals remain0; no second generic26 or spell-base is invented. If the target ritual is itself a real spell, its own paid casting/strain/counter rules apply at this actual inner commitment (a separate actual cast, unlike an embedded spell invocation that has no independent cast); true Wizard ritual strain exemption applies only to that ritual, not the outer Mastery. Nonspell Spellbook Study has no new counter window/Dissonance. Calendar maturation, preparation, true research/readiness, corpse/anchor and future maintenance are not active performance minutes.
Spellbook Study concretely replaces one prepared matrix with another legal actual book spell, preserving cap, historical first-family/Refrain, and its1/long-rest use. No roll exists for this ritual: explicitly record no roll, not automatic success on an invented check. The real leader, not necessarily Mastery's caster, supplies and spends the ritual permission. The existing source permits the same ritual's replacement only, not a new arbitrary spell.
For the Mage Lich transformation, retain the complete current source process, genuine readiness/eligibility, real risky-check procedure, explicit risk consent and actual result. Mastery cannot guarantee success or supply missing phylactery/lifecycle/campaign facts. A request without these facts is held as a whole target-ritual branch (CC194-H03); it is not a completed Lich case. Such unavailable target content does not prevent the demonstrated source-complete Spellbook Study ritual. One successful completion cannot be replayed after save/load, target substitution or ownership change; preserve original paid stages, use history and result identity.
procedure.sharedRequirements:
Use only the exact native classAccess row and a real acquired casting profile; sufficient RP or class level alone is not acquisition. The five root spells are rank9/base26/class17. Preserve all native rows and Core cards in completeSourceAndAccess. Four roots use Action/V,S,F; Ritual Mastery uses ten minutes/V,S,M/F. The focus alternative supplies no otherwise required target/substrate. Root120feet metadata is retained: Perfect/World are caster-origin authorizations with payload targets satisfying BOTH the root120-foot anchor limit and the payload's own actual geometry; this is NEW local completion, not teleporting an origin. Perfection/Ascendance are NEW Self benefits;120feet does not grant ally transfer. Mastery targets a real ritual/leader within120feet and line of effect throughout work.
Preflight actual body/voice/usable hand/focus, permitted action, known restrictions, range/line, targets and current quote. Reject known illegality before any expenditure; hidden/intervening failure after commitment spends the costs, reveals no hidden reason, supplies no substitute, and restores no previous concentration. Freeze identities, mode, payload graph, price-source versions and selected optional amounts. Commit once: Action (or start long work), RP and other charges, source-specific finite uses, prospective concentration transition, actual class protected cadence, Refrain and beginning hooks. Then open the one actual cast-interruption window. A counter pays its own costs/history; a resumed parent never overwrites that later history. Spell rank for a root interrupt is9: DC28 for the actual Wizard Counterspell card (rank1,3RP,Reaction,60feet,recharge2), using INT+PB and Core task degrees/natural shifts. Root rejection isn't a counter, and immunity to damage is not a casting permission.
NEW local invocation graph for Perfect/World/Mastery: an explicit finite directed path/tree of source IDs, with every wrapper selection and one terminal spell or ritual action named before commitment. Reject a repeated wrapper identity on one ancestor path before paying; a distinct useful nesting is legal. Do not ban rank9 payloads or count an Action, echo, reordered initiative or pulse as a new turn. Each real paid spell cast has one history/root; embedded invocation nodes are not extra Actions/casts/refund generators. Preserve payload provenance for each actual damage, healing, payment, recovery, condition and custody event. Hooks inspect their exact predicate once: actual cast, actual amount paid, successful resolution, actual damage or actual recovery are distinct. No universal anti-proc rule removes an independently satisfied source trigger. One wrapper never grants an unacquired passive class engine, item, soul, body or reaction opportunity.
Use source-specific clocks. A minute here is60 elapsed seconds from manifestation, never from each target's next turn. Each actor keeps its own regular starts/ends, budget refresh/spend, recharge ticks and Ready expiry. Idle regular turns can vent1 Dissonance only under the actual class rule; continuing magical work is not idle. Starting a root at a regular phase does not reset that phase. On death, concentration and these temporary Self benefits end; revival does not renew them. Suppression blocks only its actual scope, preserves original deadlines, causes no automatic recast, and never refunds prior payment. Actual removal requires a real acquired dispel, real rank/check/range/perception and spend; no Greater Dispel is assumed. Missing external suppression/Null/copy source facts keep that branch held, not a fabricated positive event.
Ordinary Ready uses one real Action spell cast at preparation, full payment/components/cadence/countering and held concentration, expiring at the next own regular START. A real perceived trigger and Reaction release it without a second payment/casting history; target/range revalidate at release and an effect's duration begins there. Ten-minute work cannot be ordinary Readied. The already-accepted seven-profile copied-feat Ready preparation-only allowance is preserved without extending it to these rank9 spells: no positive copied branch exists unless the exact copy source permits that rank/identity. Serialization preserves every clock, source root, resource receipt, acquisition/custody record and pending decision; loading is no in-world action or clock reset.

procedure.procedureContent:
KEEP Action,26RP,V/S/F and one minute. NEW Self, nonconcentration. Only a successfully manifested operative benefit prices subsequent actual spells cast by that identity; it never reprices its own already-paid installation. Recasting is a new legal spell, priced by any old operative copy before replacement; on success replace with a new60second deadline, on counter preserve the old effect and deadline. Death/removal ends it; suppression disables only future quotes while original time continues. Payment already committed never changes retrospectively.
NEW RP194-QUOTE: at atomic commitment compute ordinary legal price and its classified buckets first: actual mode/class rank/base, protected conversion extras, mandatory additions, current Dissonance, source reductions/waivers/minima, current Nexus/Dampening in their accepted order. Then for this local effect replace the discountable spell-casting RP total with A, the same caster pool's CURRENT unreserved spendable RP. Protected separately required principal such as nondiscountable BulwarkX and later nonspell Forge5RP is not swallowed into A or fabricated. If an actual casting requires protected X, reserve/pay that X first in the quote allocation and define A from the remaining unreserved spendable wallet; the total actual payment is A+X. This explicit NEW reservation choice is visible, not a claim that X was waived. If no protected principal, price is exactlyA, even greater than normal. Non-RP costs remain. Then apply accepted final Resonance Influence±1/min0 to the discountable result, leaving protected X intact. If this conflicts with an exact final-modifier interface for a protected bucket, hold that combination instead of silently overriding it.
A=0 permits another legal cast at0: no minimum1, one-use rule, arbitrary rank cap or automatic resource exhaustion stop. Actual Action/Reaction/component, access, strain and Fractured restrictions still apply. Cantrips with a real RP-price interface qualify; charge-only casts and nonspell techniques without one do not. Source class spells qualify only with their actual grant/rank/printed price. Do not add an RP pool to Oracle charges or import a nonspell technique by analogy.
Record exact ordinary base, extras, surcharge, reductions, A/reservations, Influence, final payment and actual funded allocation. Actual credited base is min(native eligible base, actual payment remaining after protectedX); no excess Perfection payment or strain/Influence surcharge is extra base credit. Additional X is separately actual paid. Harmonic Bulwark with credited0 fails before commitment; positive payment creates5×(actualbase+actualX) tempHP under strongest-only arbitration, no refund for a stronger existing buffer. A Burden quote A+1 exceeds an unreserved A wallet, so cannot commit and leaves Influence pending; Ease can leave1RP, or0 atA0. A stale quote must be recomputed before any costs or modifier consumption, including newly recovered/removed/reservedRP, source suppression and deadline. Successful later Soulburn recovery changes the NEXT quote; future recovery never pays this one.
Intrinsic Soulburn still pays20normalHP while remaining≥1, even when this price is0, and recovers selected0..3RP only after successful resolution. This is NEW Perfection/Soulburn pricing, not an extension of Grand Reservoir's one owner-approved exception. Exact owner Reservoir use is expended only if actually selected/acquired; no automatic combination is assumed. Record repeated full-minute regular opportunities, base/repeat Dissonance, genuine class cadence, idle vent, Ready/preparation histories, countered/no-recovery result, original suppression/expiry and save/load with no reset.
procedure.sharedRequirements:
Use only the exact native classAccess row and a real acquired casting profile; sufficient RP or class level alone is not acquisition. The five root spells are rank9/base26/class17. Preserve all native rows and Core cards in completeSourceAndAccess. Four roots use Action/V,S,F; Ritual Mastery uses ten minutes/V,S,M/F. The focus alternative supplies no otherwise required target/substrate. Root120feet metadata is retained: Perfect/World are caster-origin authorizations with payload targets satisfying BOTH the root120-foot anchor limit and the payload's own actual geometry; this is NEW local completion, not teleporting an origin. Perfection/Ascendance are NEW Self benefits;120feet does not grant ally transfer. Mastery targets a real ritual/leader within120feet and line of effect throughout work.
Preflight actual body/voice/usable hand/focus, permitted action, known restrictions, range/line, targets and current quote. Reject known illegality before any expenditure; hidden/intervening failure after commitment spends the costs, reveals no hidden reason, supplies no substitute, and restores no previous concentration. Freeze identities, mode, payload graph, price-source versions and selected optional amounts. Commit once: Action (or start long work), RP and other charges, source-specific finite uses, prospective concentration transition, actual class protected cadence, Refrain and beginning hooks. Then open the one actual cast-interruption window. A counter pays its own costs/history; a resumed parent never overwrites that later history. Spell rank for a root interrupt is9: DC28 for the actual Wizard Counterspell card (rank1,3RP,Reaction,60feet,recharge2), using INT+PB and Core task degrees/natural shifts. Root rejection isn't a counter, and immunity to damage is not a casting permission.
NEW local invocation graph for Perfect/World/Mastery: an explicit finite directed path/tree of source IDs, with every wrapper selection and one terminal spell or ritual action named before commitment. Reject a repeated wrapper identity on one ancestor path before paying; a distinct useful nesting is legal. Do not ban rank9 payloads or count an Action, echo, reordered initiative or pulse as a new turn. Each real paid spell cast has one history/root; embedded invocation nodes are not extra Actions/casts/refund generators. Preserve payload provenance for each actual damage, healing, payment, recovery, condition and custody event. Hooks inspect their exact predicate once: actual cast, actual amount paid, successful resolution, actual damage or actual recovery are distinct. No universal anti-proc rule removes an independently satisfied source trigger. One wrapper never grants an unacquired passive class engine, item, soul, body or reaction opportunity.
Use source-specific clocks. A minute here is60 elapsed seconds from manifestation, never from each target's next turn. Each actor keeps its own regular starts/ends, budget refresh/spend, recharge ticks and Ready expiry. Idle regular turns can vent1 Dissonance only under the actual class rule; continuing magical work is not idle. Starting a root at a regular phase does not reset that phase. On death, concentration and these temporary Self benefits end; revival does not renew them. Suppression blocks only its actual scope, preserves original deadlines, causes no automatic recast, and never refunds prior payment. Actual removal requires a real acquired dispel, real rank/check/range/perception and spend; no Greater Dispel is assumed. Missing external suppression/Null/copy source facts keep that branch held, not a fabricated positive event.
Ordinary Ready uses one real Action spell cast at preparation, full payment/components/cadence/countering and held concentration, expiring at the next own regular START. A real perceived trigger and Reaction release it without a second payment/casting history; target/range revalidate at release and an effect's duration begins there. Ten-minute work cannot be ordinary Readied. The already-accepted seven-profile copied-feat Ready preparation-only allowance is preserved without extending it to these rank9 spells: no positive copied branch exists unless the exact copy source permits that rank/identity. Serialization preserves every clock, source root, resource receipt, acquisition/custody record and pending decision; loading is no in-world action or clock reset.
